newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai T-bill repo rates end up, spot mixed.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai T-bill repo rates end up, spot mixed.

text.p: Contracts on the treasury bill repurchase market in Shanghai closed mostly up on Wednesday with securities houses and brokerages borrowing large amount of money on the repo market to speculate in stocks, traders said.
The annual rate for the most active seven-day contract rose slightly to 10.59 percent from 10.38 percent on Tuesday.
Turnover edged up to 7.73 million lots from 7.37 million. One lot is 1,000 yuan face value of treasury bills.
"The recent surges and active trading on the (domestic) A share market has led to many securities brokerage borrowing money on the repo market, pushing up rates," one trader said.
